analysis.title: DISCO与e-RWSC：发现集合错误不等于单题多数
analysis.body: e-RWSC认证单题某答案的政策多数概率，不等于正确性；DISCO控制多行为假设集合的误发现比例，并为自适应假设池施加分箱、冻结与null分布校正约束。相同的e-process工具不使两类错误和证书等价。 DISCO的pre-hoc证书给出无条件epsilon-alpha加delta界；post-hoc证书依赖无null退出条件，须同时保留delta失败概率。有限null路径穷举只验收本地公式与接口，不验证真实LLM的p值有效性，也不替代原文三分箱/boosted发现器及独立复验。

question.question: DISCO和e-RWSC都累积e-process，为什么不能共用一种成功证书？
question.answer: e-RWSC认证同一题某答案在固定政策iid采样中的多数概率，不保证答案正确。DISCO控制多个行为假设最终集合的误发现比例，并有自适应假设池的分箱、冻结和校正约束。认证对象与错误定义不同。
question.example: 教学例：某LLM每次都答错同一个答案，e-RWSC仍可能很快发多数证书；这不证明十个新提出的行为规律有九个真的存在，也不能代替DISCO的FDR证书。

comparison.position: DISCO freezes e-processes and coarsens hypothesis-selection feedback to control collection-level FDR with observed pool size. Local code covers only the unboosted binary-bin statistical core.
comparison.tradeoff: e-RWSC certifies one answer's policy-majority probability, not correctness. DISCO controls false discoveries across behavioral hypotheses and constrains adaptive pool size through coarsening, freezing and null-law correction. Shared e-process machinery does not equate their errors or certificates.

analysis.title: DISCO vs e-RWSC: collection errors are not single-question majorities
analysis.body: e-RWSC certifies one answer's policy-majority probability, not correctness. DISCO controls false discoveries across behavioral hypotheses and constrains adaptive pool size through coarsening, freezing and null-law correction. Shared e-process machinery does not equate their errors or certificates. DISCO's pre-hoc certificate is an unconditional epsilon-alpha-plus-delta bound. Its post-hoc certificate is conditional on no true-null exit and must retain the delta failure term. Finite null-path enumeration checks local formulas and interfaces, not real-LLM p-value validity, the three-bin/boosted discoverer or independent replication.

question.question: Why can DISCO and e-RWSC not share one success certificate despite both using e-processes?
question.answer: e-RWSC certifies one answer's majority probability under a fixed policy's iid sampling, not correctness. DISCO controls false discoveries across a final collection of behavioral hypotheses and constrains adaptive pool selection through coarsening, freezing and correction. Their certified objects and errors differ.
question.example: Illustration: a model that always gives the same wrong answer can quickly obtain an e-RWSC majority certificate. That does not establish that nine of ten proposed behavioral patterns exist or replace DISCO's FDR certificate.
